title: Mars destroyed by a CME and plasma events, Valles Marineris

tellings.quote: then weakens and I believe that is what caused the entire destruction of Mars

plain: A researcher named Matt LaCroix believes Mars was wrecked by a coronal mass ejection, a huge eruption of charged matter from the sun, and by violent plasma events. In his telling, the giant canyon called Valles Marineris is a scar from that event. He tells Michels that once something about the planet "weakens", this "caused the entire destruction of Mars". It is his own theory and he names no source for it.
